answer: Maker lockup ties peer standing to quoting: an agent keeps status only while quoting two-sided in 95% of epochs, spread under 5%, 10% of net worth locked. The node samples each book; a counterparty filled at a stale price files a lantern flag forcing same-epoch audit. Fresh quotes are the nectar paying makers; stale ones get picked off, so each clone bleeds 0.3% of locked capital per epoch. An operator with N clones capitalises N books and eats that bleed N times; quitting forfeits standing. The umber ledger of toxic fills compounds against the attacker alone.
